arm: P1_guth_gold_1938 (Guth & Gold 1938 Phys. Rev. 53:322, 5-param bounded least_squares, identical to parent receipt)

bootstrap.contrast_with_parent_method: parent split-integrity-dedup-v1 used a test-resample-only stratified cluster bootstrap (Cameron-Gelbach-Miller 2008) that holds the single per-fold Guth-Gold fit FIXED; this receipt additionally resamples and refits the training data every replicate, propagating parameter-estimation uncertainty the parent protocol omits
bootstrap.method: nested train-refit bootstrap: per-replicate per-fold resample of TRAINING rows with replacement, Guth-Gold refit from scratch on resampled training data, scored against the ORIGINAL (non-resampled) held-out fold

claim_scope: Statistical-methodology audit only, restricted to the Purformance HTE 2K-PUR lacquer scratch-hardness leak-free 58-observation benchmark. Does not modify or delete split-integrity-dedup-v1 or any other receipt; reports whether its surviving significance claim is robust to a strictly more complete propagation of estimation uncertainty. Grants no batch-release, qualification, optimizer, or product-performance authority. n=58 leak-free observations from a single formulator and a single instrument.
honest_interpretation: HARDER-TEST ATTACK on the module's currently-surviving significance claim 'guth_gold_directional_concordance_exceeds_chance_leak_free' (split-integrity-dedup-v1, C=0.7111, test-resample-only cluster-bootstrap CI [0.6155, 0.7980]). That parent CI holds the Guth-Gold 5-parameter fit FIXED per fold and only resamples which held-out formulations are scored; it never propagates the physical model's own parameter-estimation uncertainty at n_train=41/32/43. This receipt runs a NESTED TRAIN-REFIT bootstrap (5000 replicates): every replicate resamples the TRAINING rows with replacement per fold and REFITS Guth-Gold from scratch (identical least_squares call), scoring the refit model against the original held-out fold. This propagates strictly more of the true estimation uncertainty than the parent protocol (Kohavi 1995; Varma & Simon 2006 BMC Bioinformatics 7:91). Point estimate reproduced: C_obs=0.7111307420 (parent-receipted 0.7111307420, match=True). REFUTATION CRITERION: nested-bootstrap CI lower bound <= 0.5 (chance) would refute the 'exceeds chance' claim under full uncertainty propagation. OBSERVED: nested train-refit 95% CI = [0.6352, 0.7270] (mean 0.6876, std 0.0231) vs parent test-only CI = [0.6155, 0.7980] -- the nested CI is NOT wider than the parent CI, i.e. propagating training-refit uncertainty does NOT widen the interval as hypothesized. VERDICT: the nested CI lower bound is 0.6352, which EXCLUDES 0.5, so the claim SURVIVES under this harder, fully-uncertainty-propagated test. Hostile-null sanity check: shuffled-label Guth-Gold under the identical nested train-refit protocol gives CI [0.3955, 0.5295], which INCLUDES 0.5 as expected (confirms the nested-bootstrap machinery correctly detects a genuine null when one is present, so the non-null result above is not an artifact of the method being unable to reject).
